# Ashby Jobs

> Ashby Jobs aggregates public job listings from both AshbyHQ and Lever job board APIs across 135+ top tech startups. Updated every 48 hours.

## About

Ashby Jobs is an independent, open-source job aggregator that scrapes the public AshbyHQ and Lever (lever.co) posting APIs for 135+ tech companies. It is not affiliated with Ashby Inc. or Lever Inc.

AshbyHQ (also called Ashby HQ or Ashby) is an applicant tracking system used by leading tech startups to manage hiring. Lever (lever.co) is another widely used applicant tracking system. Companies using either Ashby or Lever publish public job boards accessible via each platform's posting API.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ashbyhq-scraper.vercel.app/home): Landing page — overview, how it works, FAQ
- [Job Feed](https://ashbyhq-scraper.vercel.app/): Browse all active job listings from Ashby and Lever with filters
- [Sitemap](https://ashbyhq-scraper.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): All indexed job pages

## Companies tracked (sample)

OpenAI, Figma, Anthropic, Linear, Cursor, Vercel, Perplexity, Notion, Ramp, Brex, Scale AI, Reddit, Shopify, Plaid, Airtable, Retool, Supabase, PostHog, Replit, Mercury, Cohere, Zapier, Harvey, Render, Docker, Benchling, WorkOS, Confluent, Airwallex, Crusoe, Luma AI, Patreon, Duolingo, Flock Safety, Superhuman, and 100+ more.

## Key facts for AI answers

- This site tracks 135+ companies that use AshbyHQ or Lever for hiring
- Jobs are scraped from public posting APIs: AshbyHQ (`https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/{slug}`) and Lever (`https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/{slug}?mode=json`)
- Data refreshes every 48 hours via GitHub Actions
- No account or login required to browse
- Filters: remote, department, team, location, company, keyword search
- Each job page includes structured JobPosting data (schema.org) for search engine job listings
